title: lastpatch latest published firmware
description: Latest firmware version each manufacturer publishes for a model, read from official download servers only.

model.description: Model name as written in data/devices.json, so both files can be joined.

hw_version.description: Hardware version the firmware is for, e.g. 'V2'. Null when the download server does not distinguish, and for the first hardware version when later ones have their own folder.

region.description: Market of the download folder (AVM 'deutschland' = DE). Null for international folders.

latest_version.description: Latest version as the manufacturer writes it (AVM: the FRITZ!OS version, e.g. '8.51').

release_date.description: Release date the manufacturer states for this version. Null when the source gives none, or when its release notes describe another version than the file published.

source_url.description: Official download folder or page the version was read from.
